about.title: About Nos Ilha
about.subtitle: A community-driven platform celebrating the cultural heritage and natural beauty of Brava Island, Cape Verde.

hero.heading: Preserving Heritage, Building Community
hero.intro: Nos Ilha is a cultural heritage hub—a digital bridge connecting Brava Island with the world. Through technology and community collaboration, we're preserving and celebrating the island's rich cultural memory while connecting the global diaspora to their roots and welcoming visitors who seek authentic heritage experiences.
hero.approach: Our volunteer-driven, open-source approach ensures that the platform remains true to its community roots while leveraging modern technology to showcase the authentic beauty of Brava Island.
hero.imageAlt: Community members collaborating on preserving Brava Island's heritage

communityFirst.title: Community First
communityFirst.description: Every feature we build serves the local community of Brava Island, with input from residents, business owners, and cultural experts.

culturalPreservation.title: Cultural Preservation
culturalPreservation.description: We document and preserve Brava's unique history, traditions, and stories for future generations and global audiences.

openCollaboration.title: Open Collaboration
openCollaboration.description: As an open-source project, we welcome contributions from developers, content creators, and cultural enthusiasts worldwide.

technical.heading: Technical Excellence in Service of Culture

architecture.heading: Modern Architecture
architecture.body: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Spring Boot, our platform combines cutting-edge web technology with robust backend services to deliver a fast, accessible experience for all users.

business.question: How can I add my business to the directory?
business.answer: Visit our <link>contribute page</link> for detailed instructions. We need your business name, location, contact details, description, and photos if possible. All submissions are reviewed by our volunteer team within 1-2 weeks to ensure accuracy and cultural authenticity.

photos.question: Can I contribute photos of Brava Island?
photos.answer: Yes! We especially welcome high-quality photos of landscapes, cultural events, local businesses, and daily life on Brava. Please ensure you own the photos or have permission to share them. Use the contact form above with "Content Contribution" selected to submit your photos with location details.

languages.question: Is the platform available in other languages?
languages.answer: Currently available in English only. We're actively planning Portuguese and Kriolu (Cape Verdean Crioulo) support for 2026. If you're fluent in these languages and interested in helping translate content, use the contact form with "Partnership Opportunity" selected.

development.question: How can I get involved in development?
development.answer: Nos Ilha is fully open-source! Visit our <link>GitHub repository</link> to see current issues, contribution guidelines, and the tech stack (Next.js, React, Spring Boot, Kotlin). New developers can start with "good first issue" labels, or use the contact form with "Technical Support" for guidance.
